# Hockey Computindo — Full Premium Theme Catalog

> Premium themes for Astro, Starlight, Docusaurus, Next.js, React, Angular, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Gatsby, Blazor, Bludit, Eleventy, Jekyll, Python, and .NET. Also the maker of 10 open-source SSG engines: AX, CAX (C), DAX (.NET), GAX (Go), PYCORA (Python), LUAX (Lua), BAX (Bash), ONTA (Perl), Markdownuts (PHP), and Axcora Framework. Ownership, not rental: one-time purchase, full source code, 90+ Lighthouse, SEO structure included.

Hockey Computindo is a theme shop and web architecture studio. We sell curated, hand-built static site themes that you own 100%. No subscriptions. No bloat: one CSS file, one JS file, no heavy dependencies. We also build custom web systems (headless commerce, booking, SSG, AI automation) via Fiverr escrow.

Last updated: November 2, 2026.

## Nocturne — Premium Docusaurus Template

Docusaurus, React, TypeScript, docs, blog, Decap CMS, Pagefind. Premium Docusaurus 3 documentation system built with React and TypeScript. Ships with documentation, blog, landing page, and static pages (about, pricing, services). Decap CMS pre-configured with collections for site settings, static pages in src/pages/*.md, documentation in docs/*, docs categories in _category_.json, and blog posts in blog/*. Decap CMS limits: cannot create new folders inside docs/, cannot create new _category_.json files, cannot edit docusaurus.config.ts or sidebars.ts — those must be done manually in code. Pagefind search indexes all docs at build time, runs client-side, no external service. Dark and light mode. MDX + Markdown + JSON content (src/data/home.json for home page). Site setup via docusaurus.config.ts (title, tagline, favicon, url, baseUrl, organizationName, projectName, navbar, footer). Documentation groups via docs/<group>/_category_.json with label, position, collapsed, and generated-index link. Docs articles via docs/<group>/<article>.md with frontmatter title, description, image, sidebar_position, sidebar_label. Blog authors via blog/authors.yml, tags via blog/tags.yml, posts via blog/year-month-date-slug.md with frontmatter slug, title, description, authors, tags, image, date, and {/* truncate */} for the excerpt cut (not <!-- truncate --> because MDX). Local run: npm install, npm start, open localhost:3000. Decap CMS local: npx decap-server in one terminal, npm start in another, open localhost:3000/admin/. Deploy: Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel with Docusaurus framework preset. License: one-time purchase, unlimited projects, white-label and resale allowed, lifetime updates, no renewal. $145 one-time. Demo: https://nocturne.axcora.com/ — Download: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/nocturne

## Docusar — Docusaurus Docs Template

Docusaurus, React, docs, blog, landing. Docusaurus documentation template built with React. Ships with documentation, blog, landing page, product page, contact page, and about page, plus dark and light mode, search, categories, and MDX + Markdown + JSON content. Page content driven by JSON files in data/ (Home.json, About.json, Product.json, Contact.json); documentation in docs/ with _category_.json group files and frontmatter-driven articles (title, description, image, sidebar_position); blog in blog/ with year-month-date-slug.md naming and frontmatter (slug, title, description, authors, tags), authors defined in blog/authors.yml; static pages in src/pages/ as Markdown with frontmatter. Site configuration in docusaurus.config.js (title, tagline, favicon, url, baseUrl, organizationName, projectName, themeConfig.navbar with left/right positions, themeConfig.footer with grouped links). SEO per page via JSON title, description, url, and image fields; themeConfig.image for Twitter Card and Open Graph. Optional headless CMS: Decap CMS for cloud editing or Tina CMS for local dev mode (not pre-configured). Local install: npm install, npm start, open localhost:3000. Deploy: Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel with Docusaurus framework preset. License: one-time purchase, unlimited projects, own 100% source. $75 one-time. Demo: https://docusardemo.pages.dev/ — Download: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/docusa

## Cubber — Jekyll Cyber Template

Jekyll, Ruby, JAMSTACK, cyber futuristic, multipurpose. Premium Jekyll theme with a cyber futuristic concept for multipurpose websites. Built on Ruby and Jekyll with JAMSTACK workflow. Collections: _authors (author profiles), _galleries (gallery projects), _posts (blog articles), _services (service pages). Layouts and widgets in _includes and _layouts, page templates in authors/, blog/, gallery/, and services/, static assets in assets/, site settings in _config.yml. Home content in index.md, about in about.md, contact in contact.md. Features: portfolio, gallery, blog with pagination (paginate, paginate_path), services with optional YouTube embeds, author profiles with social links, categories, tags, search page, 404 page. Navigation and widgets configured via YAML (nav, services_widget, blog, gallery, footer_nav, footer_nav_list). Contact form via Formspree (formspree_id in frontmatter). SEO auto injection: meta tags, Open Graph, Google LD JSON, sitemap, feed. Installation local: bundle install, bundle exec jekyll serve. Deploy: GitHub Pages (Settings, Build and deployment, branch, CNAME for custom domain), Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel (select Jekyll framework preset). Optional headless CMS: prose.io for quick browser editing, Decap CMS on Netlify for full admin dashboard, Tina CMS for local development. License: one-time purchase, unlimited personal and client projects, own 100% source. $65 one-time. Demo: https://cubber.pages.dev/ — Download: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/cubber-jekyll

## Nuxas — Nuxt 4 Frontend Theme for SaaS & Startup

Nuxt 4, Vue 3.5, strict TypeScript, content collections, SEO pipeline. Production-ready Nuxt 4 frontend theme built for SaaS founders, indie developers, and small teams. Ships with Nuxt 4 file-based routing and Nitro server engine, Vue 3.5 Composition API, 100% strict TypeScript across content schemas, component props, and composables, Nuxt Content 3 with schema-validated Markdown and YAML collections, @nuxtjs/seo module bundling sitemap, robots, Open Graph images, Schema.org structured data, and canonical URLs, nuxt/image, Vite build tool, dark mode with zero flicker via CSS custom properties, accessible base components with ARIA and keyboard focus states, and purchase-URL-ready product pages (Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Stripe, PayPal). Code Only — $59 (edit content in Markdown and YAML files); Code + Decap CMS — $99 (adds browser-based Decap CMS dashboard relying on Netlify Identity and Git Gateway, deployed to Netlify). Deploy anywhere: Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, cPanel shared hosting with .htaccess SPA fallback, VPS with Nginx, AWS Amplify. Build with npm run generate for static output in .output/public/; npm run build for Nitro server rendering. License: one-time purchase, unlimited personal and commercial projects, own 100% source, no resale as template or theme. Demo: https://nuxas.pages.dev/ — Docs: https://nuxas.pages.dev/docs — Code Only: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/nuxas — Code + Decap CMS: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/nuxas-cms

## ForgeDocs — All-in-One Astro Starlight Theme

Astro, Starlight, landing, documentation, blog. Premium Astro 7 + Starlight 0.42 theme combining landing page, documentation, and blog in one Astro project with a shared design system and shared navigation. Landing page: hero, showcase, features, pricing table, CTA, all JSON-driven from src/data/home.json and src/data/features.json. Documentation: Starlight with sidebar navigation, sticky table of contents, Pagefind full-text search, Markdown and MDX, sidebar supports nested groups and autogenerated directories, configured in astro.config.mjs. Blog: post list with pagination, tag filtering, detail pages, RSS feed, related posts, per-post SEO metadata from frontmatter in src/content/blog/. Static pages: about, FAQ, terms, privacy, contact, managed from a single collection in src/content/pages/ with dynamic layouts default, faq, legal, contact selected via layoutType in frontmatter. Light and dark mode with system preference detection and session persistence. SEO: meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter cards, canonical URLs, sitemap, per-page SEO from frontmatter, site-wide SEO in src/data/seo.json. JSON-driven content: src/data/seo.json, site.json, navbar.json, footer.json, home.json, features.json, contact.json, blog.json. Install: Node.js 18+, extract ZIP to a folder without spaces, npm install, npm run dev at localhost:4321, npm run build for dist/, npm run preview. Decap CMS (Code + CMS edition): public/admin/config.yml with git-gateway backend and local_backend: true for local testing; local run requires npm run build and npm run preview in terminal 1, npm run cms in terminal 2, then open http://localhost:4321/admin/. Netlify deployment: build command npm run build, publish dist, Node 20; enable Netlify Identity Invite-only and Git Gateway, invite yourself, access /admin/. Cloudflare Pages: framework preset Astro, build npm run build, output dist; no built-in Identity/Gateway, Decap requires GitHub OAuth. Vercel: auto-detected Astro, same limitation. Firebase Hosting: firebase-tools, firebase init hosting with public directory dist, then npm run build and firebase deploy. cPanel: upload dist ZIP to public_html or use Setup Node.js App. AWS S3 + CloudFront: aws s3 sync dist/, static website hosting, CloudFront for HTTPS. License: one-time purchase, unlimited personal and commercial projects, own 100% source, lifetime updates, no resale as template. Code Only $79 — https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/forgedocs; Code + Decap CMS $129 — https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/forgedocs-cms. Sidebar configured in astro.config.mjs with label and items (nestable). Group index pages: index.mdx inside the group imports a JSON from src/data/index_page/ and renders Starlight Card and CardGrid. Pagination: change pageSize in [..page].astro (example pageSize: 12). Install: Node.js, extract to astrodocu folder, npm install, npm run dev, open localhost:4321. ## Dax Pro — .NET Static Site Generator Theme

.NET, C#, static site generator, Decap CMS, Blazor alternative. Premium .NET static site generator theme built on the open-source DAX engine. Pure C# engine (single Program.cs, ~800 lines, zero external dependencies), runs on .NET 8 LTS and .NET 9. Produces pure HTML at build time with no WASM runtime, no hydration, no client-side .NET — positioned as a Blazor WASM alternative for content sites (marketing pages, blogs, documentation, service catalogs). Ships with 8 production-ready layouts (Home, About, Services, Service Detail, Blog, Blog Detail, Contact, Docs), 30+ pre-built partials (hero, trust, solutions, performance, showcase, pricing, insights, contact form, navigation, footer, SEO), Decap CMS pre-configured with 8 collections (Settings, Navbar, Footer, Homepage, Posts, Services, Pages, Contact), zero-config deployment configs for Netlify, Vercel, and Cloudflare, and a GitHub Actions workflow. Automatic SEO on every build: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, RSS feed, Open Graph meta, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD structured data. Pure semantic HTML5 + CSS3, one style.css, one main.js, zero framework dependencies, zero NPM packages, zero third-party JavaScript. WCAG 2.1 AA accessible: keyboard navigation, ARIA landmarks, screen reader support. Lighthouse 100 in Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO. Build time 0.04s for 49 pages, first paint 50ms. Content structure: _data/metadata.yaml, _data/nav.yaml, _data/footer.yaml for site-wide config; content/ for Markdown pages, posts, services, and tags with YAML frontmatter; templates/layouts and templates/partials for theme; public/ for CSS, JS, images, and admin, copied verbatim to site/ on build. Install: .NET 9 SDK required, download ZIP from Gumroad, extract to a folder without spaces, run dotnet run -- build and dotnet run -- start, open http://localhost:8080/. Decap CMS setup: enable Netlify Identity (Invite only), enable Git Gateway with GitHub personal access token (repo and workflow scopes), invite editor, remove local_backend: true from public/admin/config.yml, commit, push, log in at /admin/. Deploy: Netlify recommended (automatic builds, Netlify Identity and Git Gateway for CMS, free HTTPS and custom domain); Vercel via included vercel.json (no native Decap CMS); Cloudflare Pages requires build.sh installing .NET 9 (no native Decap CMS). Commercial license: unlimited projects, unlimited clients, own 100% source, no resale as theme. Lifetime updates. $199 one-time. Demo: https://daxpro.axcora.com — Download: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/dax-pro — Free DAX engine: https://dax.axcora.com

## BlazorForge — Blazor WebAssembly Theme

Blazor, .NET, C#, Razor, Fluent 2, Decap CMS. Production-ready Blazor WebAssembly theme built for .NET developers who need a complete, accessible, Microsoft-aligned UI foundation. Runs on .NET 8 and .NET 9. Pure C# Razor components, no JavaScript bridge, no React wrapper, no TypeScript step, zero NPM dependencies — build with dotnet publish. Microsoft Fluent 2 design system: buttons, cards, typography, spacing, elevation, and focus states match the specification used in Azure Portal, Microsoft 365 admin centers, and Entra ID dashboards. WCAG 2.1 AA accessible by design. Ships with 7 production-ready pages (home, about, contact, journal index, journal article, services index, service page) and 65 pre-built components. Built-in SEO service: page titles from template, fallback descriptions, canonical URLs from current route, Open Graph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD structured data for Organization, Article, FAQ, and Breadcrumb generated without configuration; per-page overrides via YAML frontmatter; site-wide defaults in wwwroot/data/seo.json. Decap CMS optional admin panel in two modes: local (npm install -g decap-server, local_backend: true in wwwroot/admin/config.yml, git-gateway backend, npx decap-server + dotnet run, open localhost:5052/admin/) and online (GitHub + Netlify Identity + Git Gateway). Content: Markdown with YAML frontmatter in wwwroot/content/ (home.md, about.md, contact.md, journal index, services index, journal/*.md, services/*.md); filename becomes slug automatically; after content changes run cd Tools && dotnet run && cd .. to recompile metadata. Configuration: wwwroot/data/site.json (site name, tagline, description, canonical URL, language, locale, logo text, contact, social), wwwroot/data/navbar.json (header CTA, desktop menu, mobile menu, match mode exact/prefix), wwwroot/data/footer.json (brand, trust line, social order, columns, legal), wwwroot/data/seo.json (title template, fallback description, default OG image, Twitter Card, Organization JSON-LD, Robots meta), wwwroot/css/style.css :root design tokens. Installation: .NET 9 SDK required (dotnet --version should start with 9.0), extract ZIP, dotnet run, first run 1-3 minutes, then open http://localhost:5052. Deploy: Netlify (build command dotnet publish -c Release -o publish, publish directory publish/wwwroot, enable Netlify Identity Invite-only and Git Gateway for online CMS); Cloudflare Pages via build.sh that installs .NET SDK and runs publish. Package: complete Blazor WebAssembly project, 7 pages, 65 components, Decap CMS config, Markdown content structure, Fluent 2 design tokens, sample content (5 journal articles, 4 service pages), full documentation, lifetime updates. License: $149 one-time, unlimited personal and commercial projects including client work, SaaS, and internal enterprise apps, own 100% source; no resale as theme. Demo: https://blazorforge.pages.dev/ — Download: https://creativitaz.gumroad.com/l/blazorforge

.NET static site generator by Axcora. Pure C# engine, zero NPM, for content-driven .NET sites. Powers Dax Pro. Free and open source. https://dax.axcora.com
